title: The Olympic Games
examples: How did the Olympics start originally?
What is the difference between the Olympics and the Paralympics?
What do the five rings stand for?

explain.say: The Olympic Games have a very long history you know.
The ancient games were held in Olympia in Greece a long time ago.
The modern games began much later in Athens Greece in eighteen ninety six.
The five rings represent the five inhabited continents together.
The Paralympics are for athletes with disabilities competing together.
In real life, the Olympics show people from all nations coming together.

faq.q: What do the five rings mean?
faq.a: The five rings represent the five inhabited continents together. They symbolize the unity of the world through sport.
asks: What do the five rings stand for?
Do the rings mean something specific?

faq.q: Are the ancient and modern Olympics the same?
faq.a: No, the ancient games were held in Olympia, Greece, long ago. The modern games started much later in Athens, Greece.

faq.q: Who can compete in the Paralympics?
faq.a: The Paralympics are specifically for athletes who have disabilities. They allow these athletes to compete in their sport.
asks: What is the purpose of the Paralympics?

faq.a: The Olympics are held in a different city and country each time. This keeps the games exciting for everyone.
asks: Does the location change every time?

faq.q: Is there a specific sport in the ancient games?
faq.a: The ancient games featured many sports, but the running races were very popular. Wrestling was also a common event.
asks: What did they race in the past?
Were all sports allowed in the past?

facts: The ancient Olympic Games were held in Olympia, Greece.
The modern Olympic Games were revived in Athens, Greece, in eighteen ninety six.
The five rings represent the five inhabited continents.
The Paralympics are for athletes with disabilities.

quiz.why: The rings were designed to show that all five continents are connected by sport.

wrong.1: This is tempting because many nations are involved.
wrong.2: This is tempting because many sports are shown.
wrong.3: This is tempting because many organizations exist.

quiz.say: The modern Olympic Games first started in:
quiz.why: This is the recognized starting year for the modern event.

wrong.0: This is a modern guess, but the actual start date is different.
wrong.1: This is too early; the revival happened much later.
wrong.3: This was the location of the ancient games, not the modern start.

quiz.why: The Paralympics ensure that all abilities can participate in sport.

wrong.0: While students can participate, the focus is on athletic ability.
wrong.2: This is wrong because the Paralympics are specifically for those with disabilities.
wrong.3: This is wrong because participation is based on ability, not just profession.
